provenance.operatorDescription: Removes the address from the youth, from the parent/guardian, or from both.
provenance.operatorRationale: Defect C29, separably. `courtRegisterDefendant.json` requires `address` and `courtRegisterAddress.json` requires `address1`; `courtRegisterParentGuardian.json` requires an address too. The legacy address mapper answers nothing for an absent address, so a child with no address on the payload produces a document progression answers 400 to — and ProcessOutboundCourtRegister swallows that 400 (defect C1), so the whole hearing's register is lost with no trace anywhere. An address is genuinely optional on cpp-platform-core-domain/criminal-court-public-model/src/main/resources/json/schema/global/person.json, so every variant here is an IN_CONTRACT INPUT that produces an out-of-contract OUTPUT: the pair of axes is the finding.

operatorDetail.why: the address is present and its address1 is not — courtRegisterAddress.json requires address1, so an empty-but-present address fails a DIFFERENT rule from an absent one
